entries.zh: 时间；时候；时辰；（西语 tiempo 亦指）天气
entries.en: time; hour; season; occasion; (also, as Spanish tiempo) weather
long ago; in ancient times
entries.notes: 闽南语栏例词尾部「y buens…」标记[残]，惟词头「久＝tiempo antiguo」明确，释义依词头暂定。

entries.en: formerly; of old; in olden times
temperate weather; mild climate
entries.notes: 字形「爇/爍」与音写「fier/hien」均标[疑]，义项依西语 tiempo templado 暂定。

entries.en: the time is already past; as if already gone
entries.notes: 汉字「可」、音写「fang/hang[疑]」与西语 tiempo fuera ya 三者难以互证，语义无法定夺，仅据西语暂定。

entries.en: long-lasting; prolonged (of time)
a moment; a little while
an instant; the twinkling of an eye
an opportune time; the right moment
entries.notes: 字形「隊/際」标[疑]且音写 chên 未合，义项依西语 tiempo oportuno 暂定为时机。

entries.en: season; one of the four seasons of the year
entries.notes: 「季/李」标[疑]，然音写 cùî 与「季」音密合，「李」当为形近之误。

entries.en: former days; in days gone by

entries.zh: 天色阴沉；（如冬令之）阴晦天气
entries.en: dark, overcast weather, as in winter; gloomy sky
a short while; not much time (yet)
entries.notes: 中间音节标 T99 污损难辨且栏尾[残]，惟「无几久」连读与西语 tiempo breve 相合，暂定此义。

entries.en: in a twinkling; a very brief moment
an instant; a moment
in a little while from now
entries.notes: 汉字「赫」非时义字、音写 hiá 或为「遐」、西语 de aquí aunras 疑为 de aquí a un rato，四栏难以互证。

entries.en: at that time; in those days
to idle away time; time spent in vain; lost time
years gone by; long ago; (so glossed) the year past
a very long while; for ages
for a long time; many a day
long-lasting; for a very long time
in good time; on a fair day
entries.notes: 汉字「起日」与西语 a buen tiempo 对应不明，「起」与音写 hù 不合，疑为「许日／好日」之讹，暂依西语释义。
